summary: Join our GCP Fundamentals Training Course to learn the core concepts of Google Cloud Platform. Equip yourself with the skills needed for cloud success!
lede: GCP fundamentals training covers the core services and operating decisions used to manage workloads in Google Cloud. It is for cloud administrators, infrastructure and DevOps engineers, security analysts, and reliability teams who need to configure access, deploy workloads, and monitor resource use. Learners practise selecting cloud services, setting IAM and VPC controls, and interpreting monitoring signals while considering cost and governance.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who support, plan, govern, or communicate Google Cloud workloads and need a foundation-to-intermediate operating perspective.
audience: Data Engineers using BigQuery datasets and Cloud
outcomes: Compute Engine And Cloud Run Deployment
modules: Google Cloud IAM and Resource Governance
Compute Engine and Cloud Run Deployments
Cloud Storage and BigQuery Data Foundations
Automation, Cost Control, and AI Service Awareness
GCP Integration, Security, and Adoption Roadmap
prerequisites: No prior Google Cloud certification or programming experience is required. You should have basic familiarity with operating systems, web applications, networks, or IT service operations. Basic command-line exposure helps, but guided Cloud Shell and gcloud CLI exercises support beginners. Coding is not required for completion. Advanced topics such as Terraform automation, Google Kubernetes Engine administration, and Vertex AI receive conceptual or operational treatment rather than production engineering instruction. A laptop with a modern browser is required for hands-on labs; temporary Google Cloud lab access and sample datasets should be provided by the training delivery team.
